metadata.description: GET /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationId} for a second, independent macOS full-SLM asset, RE-CAPTURED live 2026-08-01 against <internal-env>/26.2.1614.12 using the fully placeholder vendored MacOSPkgTestApp-1.0.pkg + MacOSPkgStyleTestApp-1.0.plist (chore/vendored-sdk-test-apps) -- native pkg-install Munki style (no installer_type key), replacing the original 2026-07-31 capture that used a real WS1 Assist .pkg + its shipped Munki plist, to remove real-vendor-name residue from the committed fixture. The real live-captured id (65683) was anonymized here and re-baked as the literal path /api/mam/apps/internal/67004 (unchanged from the prior capture) to preserve the established collision-avoidance routing scheme this test's other fixtures/wantLocationID/capturedAppID already depend on. Anonymized via mock-capture's Anonymize() before commit; no manual plist scrub was needed this time (source content was already fully placeholder). REAL-WIRE FINDING (still holds, reconfirmed on this placeholder re-capture): CreateMacOSApplication is confirmed the SAME endpoint/controller for both a copy_from_dmg-style asset and a native pkg-install asset (no installer_type key) -- installer_type remains purely a client-side (Munki agent) install-behavior hint the server never inspects.
